My earlier run was `uv run pytest -q tests/test_format.py` without `--golden`, but the README says the real check is `make check`, which runs `uv run pytest -q --golden tests/` and then `ruff check .`. Without `--golden`, about half the tests are skipped, so the 6 passes don't cover the recorded station tables. Rounding to 0.01 m could easily change the golden values.

I would run these in order:

<command>make check</command>

<command>grep -n "round\|0\.01" tests/test_format.py</command>

I'm not writing any `<edit>` blocks yet. What to change depends on the `make check` output, and I haven't seen the contents of `tests/test_format.py` or the golden tables. If the golden tests fail on unrounded expected values, I would stop and ask before changing them, since they're recorded data.
